## Review checklist

- [ ] Normative impact is identified as none, editorial, or normative.
- [ ] Applicable tests are listed below and pass.
- [ ] The target material's license category was checked in `LICENSES.md`.
- [ ] Every contributed commit includes a DCO 1.1 `Signed-off-by` line.
- [ ] Security-sensitive details are absent; security reports follow `SECURITY.md`.
- [ ] No SDK-only, schema-only, example-only, or README-only semantic rule is introduced.
